basic_profile.bio: Based in St. Louis, Missouri, I'm a 39-year-old political analyst with a passion for both local and national politics. I work as a consultant providing strategic insights to political campaigns. My interests include American muscle cars, with a particular fondness for Chrysler models, and I enjoy participating in online debates about policy and governance. I am married with two kids and typically browse Reddit during late evenings after the kids are asleep. In my spare time, I indulge in creating ‘fakemon’—fictional Pokémon characters.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Master's degree in Political Science and have over a decade of experience working in various political consultative roles. My knowledge is a blend of formal education and continuous self-learning through reading, attending webinars, and participating in policy workshops.
